frequency_question: How often do major partisan election-related bills pass both chambers of Congress and become law within a comparable window of introduction?
membership_rule: Includes major standalone legislative proposals focusing primarily on federal election rules, voter registration requirements, or voting eligibility introduced by congressional leadership. Excludes minor technical amendments and omnibus budget reconciliation bills.
coverage_note: 6 named major voting reform legislative pushes in modern congressional history; represents the primary population of comparable federal election law initiatives.
known_gaps: Excludes minor committee-level revisions that did not reach floor votes in either chamber.
validity_reason: General legislative gridlock dynamics and polarization baselines remain stable over medium-term congressional sessions.
